newsitem.title: CHINA: China Telecom says CSRC reviews unit's HK listing.
newsitem.headline: China Telecom says CSRC reviews unit's HK listing.

text.p: China Telecom said on Thursday the nation's top market watchdog was still reviewing a planned Hong Kong listing of a subsidiary.
"The plan is proceeding," said a company official.
China Telecom is the powerful operating arm of the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications, which regulates China's telecommunications industry.
Its China Telecom (Hong Kong) Ltd unit, is planning to list shares on the stock market of the former British colony as part of a major restructuring.
Cable & Wireless, which holds 59 percent of Hongkong Telecom, said it would sell 5.5 percent of Hongkong Telecommunications Ltd to China Telecom for $1.185 billion.
Cable & Wireless has said it was prepared to sell more Hongkong Telecom shares to China Telecom.
Officials of the China Securities Regulatory Commission declined to comment on the offering.
